class.name: VFXPresets
class.brief_description: Ready-made gameplay effects authored as VFX graph dictionaries.
class.description: [VFXPresets] bundles effects as pure data (see [VFXGraphAsset]) together with a helper that spawns a self-freeing [VFXGraphInstance3D]. All members are static.

method.name: get_spark_count
method.description: Returns the spark count for a graphics [param level] (clamped to 0..3): 0, 40, 70 or 110.

method.name: lightning_sparks
method.description: Returns a lightning ground strike graph: white-hot [code]sparks[/code] that bounce off the ground plane and spawn short-lived [code]embers[/code] on every impact through collision event routing. Level 0 yields an effect without particles.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Adds a one-shot [VFXGraphInstance3D] playing [param asset] (a graph [Dictionary] or a [VFXGraphAsset]) to [param parent] at the world position [param at]. Returns [code]null[/code] if [param parent] is [code]null[/code], [param at] is not finite or the asset has no particle capacity.
